hero.title: Watch with someone who can look anything up.
hero.description: Co-Watcher watches videos with you, researches what is being discussed, adds useful context and fact-checks, and can help turn your reactions and discovered context into finished video content.

context.title: Watch with context
context.description: Paste a YouTube video and get timestamped AI comments with useful background, people, events, concepts, and connections the video itself does not explain.

factCheck.title: Fact-check while watching
factCheck.description: Ask Co-Watcher to verify concrete claims and show supporting or contradicting evidence beside the relevant moment in the video.

personal.title: Make it personal
personal.description: Tell Co-Watcher what you already know, why you are watching, and what interests you. It changes what it chooses to comment on.

discovery.title: Find something worth watching
discovery.description: Describe a topic, question, or learning goal and let Co-Watcher find relevant videos for you.

reactions.title: Turn reactions into videos
reactions.description: React to moments you find interesting, record your own voice or camera response, reuse researched facts and images, and let Co-Watcher assemble or revise a reaction video or short.

chat.placeholder: Ask Co-Watcher anything, paste a YouTube link, or describe what you want to watch...
chat.attachTitle: Paste Video URL or Attach Document
chat.footerHint: Shift + Enter for new line • Press Enter to initiate
